notes.title: StudioFriends: ShotKill-Update 0.0.8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33711432/2a5f99963cc7b5ad4411630aa777b2640ef5edaa.png[/img]

StudioFriends: ShotKill-Update 0.0.8

Hi all,

[h1]Update - 0.0.8[/h1]

- You need create a new account
- Skin for weapons is disable for this update but is comming soon again
- Remove class in game

[h1]New Content-[/h1]

- Add New System Weather dynamic skies, cloud shadows, and procedural volumetric clouds
- Add New Post-Processing Stack V2
- Add New Slide movement this mechanic allows players to slide with the crouch key when they are sprinting forward
- Add New Weapon Grenade Launcher/Projectile Launcher item, a new weapon type that fires a specially-designed large-caliber projectile
- Add New Frame Rate selector, a dropdown in the settings menu with which players can select the update frame rate
- Add New Optional Kill Cam logic "Observed Death", the camera will be statically 
- Add New Server for South Africa Server option

[h1]Changes-[/h1]

- Update Game for Unity version 2019.4.4

[h1]More Fixes/Improvements -[/h1]

- Improve Compass Bar
- Improve Bots cover point selection, now the selection algorithm will try to select nearby points if the selected one is already occupied by another bot
- Improve Draw Name position calculation, before the UI was overlapping the player at a certain distance away, now the calculation will try to always show the hud above the player head
- Improve Now player and bots fly away when die by an explosion near them
- Improve Now the Third Person Reload animations time (that take play the whole animation) match with the First Person weapons reload time
- Improve Player animation, walk, run, jump and some weapons animations transitions have been improved for better looking
- Improve Now grenade weapons will automatically switch to the previous weapon when players throw the last grenade
- Improve Now players can't select the grenade if they don't have ammo for this
- Improve Now players can't equipped the same weapon multiple times in the same player class
- Improve Various other minor fixes
- Improve Some small optimizations in volume clouds raymarch shader

- Fixed Error when not start from the class customization scene
- Fixed Bots keep firing at dead bodies instead of search for new targets
- Fixed Shotgun reload was automatically canceled, causing that only one bullet inserted
- Fixed Hit marker randomly shows up for master client when a bot causes damage
- Fixed Bots were still able to throw grenades seconds after they die
- Fixed Weapon Camera Field Of View was not be applied on start but until the player opens the settings menu
- Fixed Sometimes pickup guns don't respond to input, it happened when two guns were next to each other and trigger area intersect between
- Fixed Player mesh for bots and player prefab get stretched at a certain distance, problem caused by LOD meshes
- Fixed Bots were destroyed when Master Client leave the room, now bots data and current state will automatically transfer to the new Master Client
- Fixed RoomScore FFA in game¨
- Fixed Bots ignored players sometimes
- Fixed Error at the end of matches when playing without bots in FFA game mode
- Fixed Error on player spawn
- Fixed Play the wrong footstep sounds for the local player
- Fixed Bullets randomly doesn't detect bots and players collision
- Fixed Bots can't damage players of the Master Client team (other than the Master Client)
- Fixed Friend list UI doesn't update when adding the first friend
- Fixed Issue with clouds lod system when over the clouds
- Fixed Possible issue with clouds shaking when camera rotates

Thanks for your support!
StudioFriends
